pages.text:
Arcforge is about power, heat and industry: burn fuel for heat, turn heat into Forge Energy (FE), make steel, and build bigger and better machines from it.
# How to read this book
- Each chapter covers one part of the mod.
- Click the items at the top of an entry to see their recipes (with JEI installed).
- Multiblock entries show the build step by step: drag to turn it, scroll or use the arrows to go layer by layer.
- In your inventory, hold Shift over any Arcforge item for a short description.
# A good path
1. Heat and power: a Firebox and a Thermoelectric Plant.
2. Steel: a Carbonizer for coal coke, then the Arcforge Furnace.
3. Processing: crush, press and smelt with FE.
4. Steam: boilers and turbines for serious power.
